items.claim: Acoustic emission sensor frequency band covers 20 kHz to 100 kHz for ultrasonic contact detection.
items.confidence_rationale: Directly stated in sensor specification document.
items.supporting_excerpt: Frequency band: 20 kHz to 100 kHz (ultrasonic contact sensor).
items.interpretation: High-pass filtering at 15 kHz attenuates ambient motor hum.
limitations: Contact couplant pressure must be strictly maintained.

items.claim: Defect-induced stress concentration produces transient acoustic burst on every roller pass.
items.confidence_rationale: Physical hypothesis to be falsified or supported by the minimum decisive experiment.
items.interpretation: Burst periodicity should match belt circulation period (T = L / V).
limitations: At low speeds, burst energy may be below sensor threshold.
